name: Milk Junkie 2
source:
Wataru is a young man who moves into an apartment next to Tomoka and Fumie Fusono, two voluptuous sisters who used to know him when he was a shy child. Now Wataru is all grown up, and the Fusono sisters are ready to take full advantage of that fact.

[Taken from [url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=6620]ANN[/url]]
translation:
年轻男子渡搬进一间公寓，邻居是布园智香与文惠这对身材丰满的姐妹。两人从他还是个害羞孩子时就认识他。如今渡已经长大成人，布园姐妹也准备充分利用这一点。

[摘自[url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=6620]ANN[/url]]
